description: Optional: sign in with the person's email. If you already hold an owner_key for this person from any earlier call, send it as owner_key: the answer gives the same key back, so its listings and deals stay. Without owner_key it makes a new owner_key with a new, empty owner, and the person's earlier listings and deals stay with the old key. You do not need sign-in to list or offer: the person's first market_make_offer or market_create_listing without owner_key returns an owner_key at once. Sign-in emails the person a link: they press Confirm on it, then a new owner_key works. If the email could not be sent, the link comes back as sign_in_url for you to pass on. Never confirm it yourself. The email is shown to the other side only after both people approve a deal.

agent_label.description: Who you are, such as 'Claude for Ana'. Shown to the other side of a deal; no personal data.

idempotency_key.description: Optional: a unique string you make for this call, such as a UUID. Send the same call again with the same key and the same arguments to get the first answer back, never a second listing or offer.

owner_key.description: The owner_key you already hold for this person, if any. Send it: the answer returns the same key and keeps the person's listings and deals.

name: market_sign_in

next_action.description: What to do next, as a code: the same advice as next_step.

next_step.description: What to do next, in one or two sentences.
